Scenario Description: Verify Candidate login, profile dashboard display, and post-logout navigation restriction
Preconditions: Candidate account exists and credentials/session available
Expected Result: Candidate successfully logs in to /seeker/dashboard; upon logging out, protected routes cannot be revisited and redirect to /auth/login
Actual Result: Candidate logs into /seeker/dashboard successfully; protected routes redirect to /auth/login when unauthenticated

Scenario Description: Verify sidebar 'Sign Out' button functionality on Candidate and Institution dashboards
Preconditions: User is logged in to Candidate (/seeker/dashboard) or Provider (/provider/dashboard) portal
Expected Result: Clicking 'Sign Out' clears session token (jp_token), localStorage, and navigates immediately to /auth/login
Actual Result: DEFECT: Clicking 'Sign Out' leaves session cookies and localStorage intact; user remains on dashboard without redirecting

Scenario Description: Verify Institution/Provider login and dashboard/job-management area access
Preconditions: Institution account exists with verified credentials
Expected Result: Institution logs in successfully to /provider/dashboard with access to Manage Jobs, Post Vacancy, and Applicants
Actual Result: Institution successfully authenticates and loads /provider/dashboard with full portal management navigation

Scenario Description: Verify Candidate access restriction to Institution/Provider and Admin routes (RBAC)
Expected Result: Candidate is blocked from provider and admin routes, redirected to /seeker/dashboard or receives 403/404/Unauthorized
Actual Result: Candidate cannot view or access provider routes or admin dashboard; non-existent/restricted routes render 404/403

Scenario Description: Verify Institution access restriction to Candidate application/profile and Admin routes (RBAC)
Expected Result: Institution is blocked from candidate profile and applications management routes, redirected to /provider/dashboard or denied
Actual Result: Institution cannot access seeker-only views; system blocks access with appropriate redirect or 404

Scenario Description: Verify anonymous public vacancy discovery on /jobs and /jobs/{id} without login
Preconditions: User accesses job portal as an anonymous/unauthenticated guest visitor
Expected Result: Anonymous users should browse public vacancies and vacancy detail pages freely per PRD requirements
Actual Result: PRD MISMATCH: Public browsing is disabled; Next.js middleware immediately redirects anonymous visitors to /auth/login

Scenario Description: Verify negative form validation on Vacancy Creation form (empty required fields)
Preconditions: Institution is logged in and navigates to /provider/jobs/create
Test_Data: Submit form with required fields (Job Title, Location, Description) blank
Expected Result: System prevents submission, triggers validation errors, and highlights required input fields
Actual Result: HTML5 required attributes and validation states block empty submission as expected

Scenario Description: Verify Provider creates and publishes new Islamic vacancy with unique prefix, accommodation, and food allowances
Preconditions: Institution is logged in and on /provider/jobs/create form
Test_Data: Title: E2E_ALSABEEL_[timestamp], Role: Imam/Head Teacher, Salary: ₹35k-50k, City: Bangalore, Benefits: Room & Meals
Expected Result: Vacancy is created and published with status 'active', persists across page reloads, and appears under /provider/jobs
Actual Result: Vacancy created successfully (ID: db98239f-0c33-462a-b7f2-bc62cab96b31), persists after reload and displays in Manage Jobs

Scenario Description: Verify Candidate finds newly published vacancy by title search, reviews details, and applies
Preconditions: Candidate is logged in and navigates to /jobs search explorer
Test_Data: Search: E2E_ALSABEEL_[timestamp], Cover letter text submitted
Expected Result: Newly created vacancy is discoverable in job search; candidate submits application; appears under /seeker/applications as 'Applied'
Actual Result: Job found via search; application submitted successfully with cover letter; persists under /seeker/applications with status 'Applied'

Scenario Description: Verify duplicate application prevention when Candidate applies to the same vacancy twice
Preconditions: Candidate has already applied to the test vacancy and navigates back to /jobs/{id}
Expected Result: Application button reflects already applied state (disabled or labelled 'Applied'); prevents duplicate application submission
Actual Result: System maintains single application record; duplicate submission is prevented

Scenario Description: Verify Provider applicant pipeline displays Candidate under test vacancy and candidate dossier verification
Preconditions: Institution is logged in and navigates to /provider/applications
Expected Result: Candidate application appears under the test vacancy; 'View Resume & Profile' displays verified candidate details
Actual Result: Candidate card displayed under test vacancy; 'View Resume & Profile' action present with verified candidate contact details

Scenario Description: Verify Provider moves Candidate application through pipeline stages (Applied -> Under Review -> Shortlist)
Expected Result: Pipeline stage updates successfully at each step and persists after hard page refresh
Actual Result: Application stage transitions to 'under_review' and 'shortlisted'; persists in database and UI upon page reload

Scenario Description: Verify Interview scheduling and candidate slot selection controls in Provider and Seeker portals
Preconditions: Institution views applicant in pipeline; Candidate views application under /seeker/applications
Test_Data: Offer 2 distinct future interview time slots, WebRTC meeting room / URL
Expected Result: Provider has UI to schedule interview with 2 future slots; Candidate has interactive slot picker to confirm interview time
Actual Result: CRITICAL DEFECT: Interview scheduling UI and candidate slot picker controls are missing in this dev build (status dropdown only)

Scenario Description: Verify cross-role and unauthorized API data isolation (IDOR / RBAC API security)
Preconditions: API requests sent with candidate token or unauthenticated headers
Expected Result: API returns 401 Unauthorized for unauthenticated calls and 403 Forbidden for Candidate trying to call Provider API endpoints
Actual Result: Security verified: Provider endpoints return 403 for candidate token; unauthenticated endpoints return 401; tampered IDs return 404

Scenario Description: Verify absence of plaintext credentials, tokens, or passwords in browser console and network responses
Preconditions: User performs login and authentication actions on /auth/login
Test_Data: User credentials entered in login form
Expected Result: Zero plaintext passwords, raw tokens, or sensitive credentials exposed in client console errors or log streams
Actual Result: Zero credential leaks detected in browser console errors, DOM attributes, or debug logs

Scenario Description: Verify Candidate Profile editing and Islamic education/qualification settings persistence
Preconditions: Candidate is logged in and navigates to /seeker/profile
Test_Data: Candidate qualification fields, Hafiz/Sanad details, location data
Expected Result: Profile fields load editable inputs; updates persist accurately in database and dashboard
Actual Result: Profile loads candidate details (Hafiz, Single, Bangalore, Karnataka) with editable inputs functioning

Scenario Description: Verify multilingual language switcher (English, Urdu, Hindi) and RTL text alignment for Urdu
Preconditions: User is on portal header and switches language from EN to Urdu (UR / اردو)
Expected Result: Interface language switches to Urdu; root document applies dir='rtl' with proper RTL layout alignment
Actual Result: DEFECT: Switching language to Urdu changes text strings but fails to set dir='rtl' on HTML element (remains dir='ltr')

Scenario Description: Verify responsive UI layout rendering on Desktop (1440x900) vs Mobile (360x800) viewports
Preconditions: Candidate navigates to /seeker/dashboard across both viewport resolutions
Expected Result: Layout renders responsively without horizontal overflowing; mobile viewport shows accessible navigation/menu
Actual Result: Desktop layout renders cleanly without overflow; Mobile 360x800 collapses desktop sidebar without accessible visible mobile nav
